items.title: Bruce Lehrmann makes legal bid for Brittany Higgins documentary footage
items.description: Former Liberal staffer Bruce Lehrmann has asked a court to order the company behind a film involving Brittany Higgins to hand over raw footage.

items.title: Gina Rinehart says Qld should give some of its islands to Elon Musk
items.description: The mining magnate, speaking at the National Bush Summit, also talked about how she believed Townsville could become a base for the Israeli military.

items.title: Migration dips as Coalition accuses government of failing to meet targets
items.description: Net overseas migration remained above 300,000 last year, fuelling opposition claims Labor has locked in an unsustainable new normal despite the number of arrivals continuing to fall.

items.title: A big orange bulldozer is ploughing its way through the political arena
items.description: Four years ago, Australians decided they didn't want a bulldozer for a prime minister. But now if Gina Rinehart has her way, a big orange one will be ploughing her way through the political arena.

items.title: 'Took my breath away': Afghanistan gallery opening soon at Australian War Memorial
items.description: Australian War Memorial director Matt Anderson is asked about an invitation issued to Ben Roberts-Smith, who has been accused of war crimes, to the upcoming opening of a new gallery space dedicated to Australia's service in Afghanistan.

items.title: The 2 minutes and 46 seconds of Hanson's speech that she thinks matters
items.description: When Pauline Hanson stood up at the National Press Club, it was not just for the audience watching on broadcast TV. In the age of social media, the bite-sized clips that come later are far more important.

items.title: Warning over Australia's ambitions to be global data centre hotspot
items.description: As data centres rapidly come online to meet demand, governments are urged to ensure development does not outpace adequate planning.

items.title: Fans push back against Trump administration's anime posts
